---
title: "Kantsoner uten vegetasjon langs vassdrag i lavlandet"
author: "Jenny Hansen"
format: html
editor: visual
---

Load required libraries

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(duckdb)
library(DBI)
library(glue)
library(mapview)
library(terra)
library(igraph)

```

Import data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# Akershus boundary
akershus <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/AdministrativeUnits/Norway_AdministrativeUnits/Original/Norway_County/versjon2024/Administrative_enheter_fylker_2024_FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_Fylker2024_FGDB.gdb", layer = "fylke")

# FKB-Vann (buffer by 10 m) 
vassdrag <- st_read("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/FKB-Vann_Akershus.gpkg", layer = "fkbvann") %>% 
  select(OBJECTID, objtype, medium) %>% 
  filter(objtype %in% c("ElvBekk", "Elvekant", "Innsjøkant"),
         medium != "U") %>% 
  st_buffer(10)

# Forest and myr data (AR5)
skog_myr <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/Topography/Norway_FKB/Original/FKB-AR5 FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_FKB-AR5_FGDB.gdb", layer = "fkb_ar5_omrade") %>% 
  filter(arealtype %in% c(30,60)) %>% 
  select(lokalid, arealtype) %>% 
  rename(geom = SHAPE)

# fjellområde (fra: https://nedlasting.miljodirektoratet.no/Fjellavgrensing/Fjellarealet_i_Norge.pdf)
fjell <- st_read("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/Fjell_norge_publisering.gdb", layer = "Modellert_fjell_50") %>% 
  st_transform(25832) %>% 
  st_filter(akershus, .predicate = st_intersects) %>% 
  st_intersection(akershus)

# add CHM and remove areas with vegetation above 2 m
# Canopy Height Model classification was done in Google Earth Engine:
# https://code.earthengine.google.com/bae90ed14775ac4adac711981634e6e4
chm_bin <- rast("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/akershus_chm_binary_10m.tif")
```

Remove vassdrag inside fjellområder

```{r}

# filter for features that do not intersect fjell
v_outside_fjell <- vassdrag %>% 
  st_filter(fjell, .predicate = st_disjoint)

```

Export data for out of session SQL intersection

```{r}

# skog
st_write(skog_myr, "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/skog_myr.shp", delete_dsn = TRUE)

# buffered vassdrag outside of fjell
st_write(v_outside_fjell, "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/vassdrag.shp", delete_dsn = TRUE)

```

Set up db connection and parameters

```{r}

con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
dbExecute(con, "INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;")

skog_myr_path <- "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/skog_myr.shp"
vass_path <- "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/vassdrag.shp"

dbExecute(con, 
          glue("CREATE TABLE skog_myr AS SELECT * FROM ST_Read('{skog_myr_path}')"))
dbExecute(con, 
          glue("CREATE TABLE vass AS SELECT * FROM ST_Read('{vass_path}')"))

dbGetQuery(con, "describe skog_myr")
dbGetQuery(con, "describe vass")

```

Remove vassdrag adjacent to skog and myr.

```{r}

query <- "
  WITH candidate_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
      v.OBJECTID,
      s.lokalid,
      v.geom AS vass_geom,
      s.geom AS skog_myr_geom
    FROM vass AS v, skog_myr AS s
    WHERE ST_Disjoint(v.geom, s.geom)
  )
  SELECT 
    v.OBJECTID,
    ST_AsWKB(v.geom) AS geom_wkb
  FROM vass v
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM skog_myr s
    WHERE ST_Intersects(v.geom, s.geom)
)
"

res <- dbSendQuery(con, query)
vass_outside_skog_myr <- dbFetch(res)
dbClearResult(res)

# convert to sf object
geom_sfc <- st_as_sfc(vass_outside_skog_myr$geom_wkb, 
                      crs = 25832)

vass_kant_uten_skog_myr <- vass_outside_skog_myr %>%
  select(-geom_wkb) %>%
  mutate(geometry = geom_sfc) %>%
  st_sf()
```

Find areas that overlap CHM raster with '1' values- less than 2 m vegetation

```{r echo=FALSE}

# trying zonal statistics with rasterized polygons instead
kant_uten_skog_myr_vect <- vect(vass_kant_uten_skog_myr)

# give each polygon an ID
kant_uten_skog_myr_vect$id <- 1:nrow(kant_uten_skog_myr_vect)

# rasterize polygons to match CHM
pol_rast <- rasterize(kant_uten_skog_myr_vect, chm_bin, field = "id")

# get CHM proportion over each cell
z <- zonal(chm_bin, pol_rast, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)

# assign value
kant_uten_skog_myr_vect$veg_low_prop <- 
  z$low_veg_binary[match(kant_uten_skog_myr_vect$id, z$id)]

# filter for polygons that contain at least 75% veg under 2 m
kant_filter <- st_as_sf(kant_uten_skog_myr_vect) %>%
  filter(veg_low_prop > 0.75)

```

Find suitable areas

```{r echo=FALSE}

# identify intersecting polygons
nb <- st_intersects(kant_filter)

# convert to graph
g <- graph_from_adj_list(nb)

# find connected components
groups <- components(g)$membership

# dissolve 
vkus_dissolved <- kant_filter %>% 
  mutate(group_id = groups) %>% 
  group_by(group_id) %>% 
  summarise(do_union = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(area = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)))
```

Filter for areas 1000 sq. m or larger

```{r echo=FALSE}

vkus_filtered <- vkus_dissolved %>% 
  filter(area >= 1000)

# filter vass kant that overlap for visualization
vass_filter <- vassdrag |> 
  st_filter(vkus_filtered, .predicate = st_intersects)

```

Export data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# write to scratch temporarily and copy to P drive
out_gpkg <- "/data/scratch/tmp_ida/gpkg/vassdrag_kant_lavland_uten_vegetasjon_v4.gpkg"
st_write(vkus_filtered, out_gpkg, layer = "kantsoner_vassdrag", append = FALSE)

file.copy(
  from = out_gpkg,
  to = "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Kriteriekart/vassdrag_kant_lavland_uten_vegetasjon_v4.gpkg",
  overwrite = TRUE)

```
